summary: Completed backend + frontend regression on preview URL for customer tab workflows, auth/session, admin quick-find across requested sections, live product visibility sync, and favicon/PWA assets. Core flows passed with one critical backend CORS preflight failure and one frontend runtime console error observed during StoreHome rendering.

critical.issue: Preflight from https://dashboard-design-20.preview.emergentagent.com returns 400 instead of 200/204 with credential headers.

ui_bugs.issue: Console captured runtime page error: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'image').

integration_issues.flow: Customer homepage rendering after route transitions
integration_issues.issue: Intermittent runtime error appears in console during StoreHome lifecycle despite page mostly rendering.

action_items: Fix auth CORS preflight handling so OPTIONS /api/auth/login returns allowed origin + allow-credentials for preview origin.
Investigate StoreHome undefined image runtime path (likely unsafe index/assumption around product arrays) and add guardrails/error boundary.
Re-run browser smoke specifically for homepage transitions after StoreHome fix to ensure no console runtime errors.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py exceeds 1300 lines; split auth, catalog, and admin routes into modules for maintainability and safer regressions.
CORS config in server.py still does not satisfy preview-origin credentialed preflight at runtime.
Frontend already uses env-based API URL and has data-testid coverage for key interactions, which helped reliable automation.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all requested workflows passed except runtime console error finding)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST lockout user via /api/auth/register and temporary admin product TEST UI LIVE <marker>; attempted cleanup via admin UI delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated customer routes (home/logo/category/search/product/zoom/cart-gating/auctions/sell/account), mobile bottom nav, admin quick-find input across Products/Orders/Wallet/Banners/Coupons/Settings, Google button regression (present on customer login; absent on admin login), and live storefront auto-update within 20s after admin publish. Favicon/apple-touch/png/manifest all returned 200 and manifest includes MobileCart + 192/512 icons. Logout behavior verified: session persisted before signout and ended only after account-signout-button.
rca of the issue: 1) CORS: Reproduced with direct OPTIONS call to /api/auth/login including Origin and Access-Control-Request-* headers; backend returns 400, indicating origin/method/header mismatch in runtime CORS behavior. 2) StoreHome runtime error: console shows 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading image)' with React component error warning, suggesting an unguarded product array access path during StoreHome render/transitions.
